excluded_categories: Unlisted pytest temporary directories and SQLite databases
scope: Complete selected 12-command development history and independent review, with candidate Git verification only.
redaction_policy: Zero sensitive values found; zero field redactions/exceptions. Ordered path substitutions only; no outcome rewritten.

transformation_rules.name: local_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: raw_home stripped of trailing slash, followed by slash

transformation_rules.name: ci_home_slash
transformation_rules.find_parameter: ci_home stripped of trailing slash, followed by slash

transformation_rules.name: pytest_user_root
transformation_rules.find_parameter: pytest temporary-root prefix followed by basename(raw_home)

aggregate_rule: SHA256 canonical UTF-8 JSON of files/generated_files, sort_keys=True,separators comma/colon,ensure_ascii=False
path_rules: Raw .patch/.diff names become .patch.log/.diff.log; raw alias mapping is authoritative.
